name: twinery-mcp-poc
description: POC of an MCP server that lets an LLM author and iterate on branching Twine 2 stories — 15-tool authoring surface with the open / inspect / save loop (load_story, current_story_info, dirty-flag tracking) plus image placeholders and an LLM-facing guide resource. See specs/001-mcp-server-mvp/ for the full v1.0 plan.
